title: Sources: the EU is set to fine Google hundreds of millions of euros over alleged self-preferencing of its services in Search and restrictions on app developers (Barbara Moens/Financial Times)
summary: Barbara Moens / Financial Times: Sources: the EU is set to fine Google hundreds of millions of euros over alleged self-preferencing of its services in Search and restrictions on app developers — Decisions will test whether the EU can police digital markets without reigniting tensions with Washington
